text: 创业板指跌超1%，沪指涨0.3%，深成指跌0.48%，6G、玻璃基板、CPO、卫星导航等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超2600只
text_en: ChiNext Index falls over 1%, Shanghai Composite rises 0.3%, Shenzhen Component Index drops 0.48%, with 6G, glass substrates, CPO, and satellite navigation sectors leading declines, and over 2,600 stocks falling across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
